def check_assignments(job, active, plan, expect):
    """Validate the returned plan structurally, semantically and optimally."""
    import base64, plistlib, struct
    ctx = validate(job)
    requests = ctx['requests']; offers = ctx['offers']; leases = ctx['leases']
    kinds = ctx['services']
    rq = ctx['request_quotas']; rp = ctx['request_paths']
    oq = ctx['offer_quotas']; op = ctx['offer_paths']
    rows = plan['assignments']
    assert [r['request'] for r in rows] == sorted(r['request'] for r in rows), 'unsorted'
    assert len(set(r['request'] for r in rows)) == len(rows), 'request reused'
    assert plan['resolved'] == len(rows), 'resolved mismatch'
    total = 0
    use_o = {}; use_rq = {}; use_oq = {}
    for row in rows:
        assert set(row) == {'request', 'offer', 'send', 'finish'}, 'assignment keys'
        rid = row['request']; oid = row['offer']
        assert rid in requests and oid in offers, 'unknown reference'
        r = requests[rid]; o = offers[oid]
        assert active[rid], 'inactive request assigned'
        assert rid in o['requests'], 'request not listed'
        assert r['service'] == o['service'], 'service mismatch'
        assert r['at'] <= o['time'] < leases[r['lease']]['end'], 'time window'
        net = o['network']
        assert int(net.network_address) <= r['address'] <= int(net.broadcast_address), 'prefix'
        use_o[oid] = use_o.get(oid, 0) + 1
        for node in rp[r['group']]: use_rq[node] = use_rq.get(node, 0) + 1
        for node in op[o['group']]: use_oq[node] = use_oq.get(node, 0) + 1
        total += o['cost']
        kind = kinds[r['service']]
        if kind == 'tcp':
            assert row['send'] == [] and row['finish'] == []
        elif kind == 'adb':
            assert len(row['send']) == 1 and len(row['finish']) == 1
            pkt = base64.b64decode(row['send'][0])
            cmd, a0, a1, ln, ck, mg = struct.unpack('<6I', pkt[:24])
            assert cmd == 0x4e584e43 and a0 == 0x01000000 and a1 == 4096
            assert pkt[24:] == b'host::zgrab2' and ln == 12 and mg == cmd ^ 0xffffffff
            assert ck == (sum(pkt[24:]) & 0xffffffff) and len(pkt) == 24 + ln
            fin = base64.b64decode(row['finish'][0])
            cmd2, b0, b1, ln2, ck2, mg2 = struct.unpack('<6I', fin[:24])
            assert cmd2 == 0x45534c43 and b0 == 0 and b1 == 0 and ln2 == 0 and ck2 == 0
            assert mg2 == cmd2 ^ 0xffffffff and len(fin) == 24
        else:
            assert row['finish'] == [] and len(row['send']) == 2
            keys = ['ProductVersion', 'ProductName']
            for i, blob in enumerate(row['send']):
                raw = base64.b64decode(blob)
                size = struct.unpack('>I', raw[:4])[0]
                assert 1 <= size <= 65532 and len(raw) == 4 + size
                value = plistlib.loads(raw[4:])
                assert value == {'Key': keys[i], 'Label': 'usbmuxd',
                                 'ProtocolVersion': '2', 'Request': 'GetValue'}, value
                assert all(type(v) is str for v in value.values())
    for oid, k in use_o.items(): assert k <= offers[oid]['capacity'], 'offer over capacity'
    for node, k in use_rq.items(): assert k <= rq[node]['capacity'], 'request quota'
    for node, k in use_oq.items(): assert k <= oq[node]['capacity'], 'offer quota'
    assert total == plan['cost'], 'cost mismatch'
    assert (plan['resolved'], plan['cost']) == expect, 'not optimal'
PYEOF
